_fix_distractors: C (8) — the wrong sentence is fine, its EXPLANATION is not: the span underlines the wrong
fragment, or the correction contradicts the example. Every one of these is checked against the
circular rule before it is written — substitute the correction for the span and the example has
to come back — so a fix that does not close the loop is reported instead of applied.
C.2 is written differently from the document. The document proposed `What today are` → `What
are`, which yields «What are your symptoms?» and loses «today»: the loop stays open and the next
validation pass would scrap the row. The span is widened to cover the whole re-ordering.
